subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Have fun using Unit 1 words about the planet and the weather.
Complete sentences with must, should and mustn’t.
Report questions and commands in reported speech.

tf.s: “We should switch off lights” is a sentence about saving energy.
tf.why: Yes, switching off lights saves energy.

tf.s: ‘Close the door.’ is reported as “He told me to close the door.”
‘What is a heatwave?’ is reported as “She asked me what is a heatwave.”
tf.why: We say: She asked me what a heatwave was.

tf.s: A tornado is an extreme weather word.
tf.why: Right! A tornado is a very strong storm.

tf.s: “We must to recycle paper” is correct.
tf.why: Must is followed by the base verb: We must recycle paper.

tf.s: Saving water is a way to protect our planet.
tf.why: Great! Saving water helps the planet.
Mustn’t = don’t do it; needn’t = not necessary.

tf.s: Climate change is a solution for our planet.
tf.why: Climate change is one of the planet’s problems.

tf.s: ‘Don’t waste water!’ is reported as “She told me not to waste water.”
tf.why: Yes, negative commands use not to.

tf.s: Pollution means the air and water are clean.
tf.why: Pollution makes air and water dirty.

boxes.q: Which is an extreme weather word?

o: He told me to close the window.
He asked me close the window.
He told me closing the window.
She asked me if I recycled.
She asked me do you recycle.

boxes.q: We ___ wear a helmet on a bike. (necessary)
Which is a problem for our planet?
boxes.why: Global warming is a big problem.

boxes.q: A long time with no rain is a…
boxes.why: Drought = no rain for a long time.

boxes.q: You ___ bring a pen. I have lots. (not necessary)
boxes.why: Needn’t means it is not necessary.

boxes.q: We ___ throw rubbish on the beach.
boxes.why: Throwing rubbish is not the right thing to do.

o: He asked me where I lived.
He asked me where do I live.
boxes.why: Keep the question word and use normal word order.

hunt.q: He told me ___ close the door.

mcq.q: Which sentence about saving energy is correct?
o: We should to switch off lights.

mcq.q: Which pair are both extreme weather words?
mcq.why: Tornadoes and droughts are extreme weather.

mcq.q: Which word do we use to report a command?
mcq.why: We report commands with told + object + to.

mcq.q: Which phrase is a way to help the planet?
mcq.why: Picking up rubbish keeps places clean.

mcq.q: Report: ‘What is a heatwave?’ (She asked me)
o: She asked me what a heatwave was.
She asked me what is a heatwave.
She told me what a heatwave.
She asked me if what a heatwave was.

mcq.q: Complete with the correct modal: “You ___ leave the tap on. It wastes water.”
mcq.why: Leaving the tap on is not the right thing to do.

mcq.q: Report: ‘Please plant a tree.’ (The teacher / us)
o: The teacher told us to plant a tree.
The teacher told us plant a tree.
The teacher asked us if plant a tree.
The teacher told us to planting a tree.

mcq.q: Which sentence uses the correct modal for the meaning “it is not allowed”?
o: You mustn’t throw rubbish in the sea.
You needn’t throw rubbish in the sea.
You should throw rubbish in the sea.
You need to throw rubbish in the sea.
mcq.why: Mustn’t means it is not allowed.

mcq.q: Find the mistake: “He told me don’t waste energy.”
o: It should be “not to waste energy”.
mcq.why: Negative commands are reported with not to.

mcq.q: Which is the best answer to the Unit 1 question “What can we do to protect our planet?”
o: We can recycle, save energy and plant trees.
We can waste water and energy.
We can leave lights on all day.
mcq.why: These actions help protect the planet.
